summary: An excerpt from a fiction novel (labeled Book 2, part 83) in which a narrator and a companion, Tresting, are confronted by a nondescript woman and her partner who hold laser sights on them, with snipers covering from above. The narrator relishes the danger, deliberately stalls, then draws two concealed guns and fires, sending the laser dots away, and a brief brawl erupts in which Tresting knocks out the woman and the narrator kicks the man after a gun misfires.
one_line: In a tense standoff, the narrator and Tresting draw guns against a woman and man with laser sights and snipers, starting a brawl on a hiking trail.
key_facts: A nondescript woman appears with an equally nondescript man right next to the narrator and companions.
The woman says the laser sights are more an incentive to accompany them than a threat, because her people prefer not to kill the narrator.
The narrator remarks that the situation is hard to take seriously now, calling it like a cheesy action movie.
The narrator calculates wind speed and trajectories while assuming the snipers are dialed in correctly.
Tresting tells the group that they are not coming and that things will go bad if they are forced, adding that the boss seemed to understand.
The narrator says he has an alternative: the snipers should back off and they will live.
Each of the narrator and Tresting receives two laser dots, four in total, each traced to one of four snipers.
The woman says she has been authorized as to alternatives and recommends the narrator come with her.
The narrator draws two guns and fires two shots with each hand, and the red dots disappear from their chests.
A passing hiker screams and pandemonium erupts.
Tresting delivers a vicious uppercut that drops the woman like a sack of potatoes.
The narrator's right-hand gun fails to fire at the man, so the narrator kicks him in the face instead.

entities.name: Tresting
entities.role: companion of the narrator who warns the group and delivers an uppercut to the woman

entities.name: nondescript woman
entities.role: leader-like figure who uses laser sights and offers the narrator alternatives to coming along

entities.name: nondescript man
entities.role: partner of the woman who is kicked in the face by the narrator after his gun fails
